Disable/Enable Developer Mode For Users By Admin

Functionality:

  1. This module allows to admin to set up user to allow debug/developer mode for users.

  2. Users without access to ' Debug Mode' will be redirected back without the debug mode.

  3. Users with access to 'Enable Debug Mode' will be able to access the debug mode.

Key Features

Enable/Disable Developer Mode For Users

Admin user configuration to allow debug mode for user

By default admin user has allow access and other to debug mode options unless added to 'Allow Developer Mode' group.
